tasks.task: Design a URL-shortener service: define the HTTP API (create + resolve), the storage schema, and the module boundaries the api and ui subtasks will build against. Write the design to docs/design.md.
Implement the URL-shortener HTTP API per docs/design.md: the create and resolve endpoints, validation, and persistence. Cover the endpoints with tests that drive real requests.
tasks.done_when: create and resolve work through real HTTP requests, invalid input is rejected, persistence is covered, and the full gate passes

tasks.task: Build the URL-shortener web UI per docs/design.md: a form to create a short link and a view of the result. Match the existing component patterns and keep it accessible.
tasks.done_when: a user-facing test creates a short link through the rendered accessible form and the full gate passes

tasks.task: Write the README for the URL shortener: what it is, how to run it, and the API surface. Verify every command against the code.
Review the URL shortener end to end (api + ui + docs) for correctness, missing edge cases, and security. Report verified, severity-ranked findings.
